source: Public scikit-learn GitHub issues with independently applied maintainer labels
selection: First 15 results per category by descending creation time from 25 fetched; exclude overlapping four task labels, duplicates and missing body
inputs: Source title and body, prefix truncated at 9000 characters; no maintainer labels forwarded to inference

known_choices.label: Bug
known_choices.description: Incorrect behavior of scikit-learn code or estimators, numerical or API regressions. Excludes packaging, installation, CI and build infrastructure failures.

known_choices.label: Enhancement
known_choices.description: Feature requests, proposed API improvements or new estimator functionality. Excludes build, packaging and CI infrastructure.

known_choices.label: Documentation
known_choices.description: Errors, omissions or improvements to user documentation, examples or docstrings. Excludes infrastructure.

external_side_effect_scope: Create local workspace/project/events/runs/proposals only; do not modify upstream GitHub issues
limitations: Curated public issues are not a customer production stream
No synthetic or translated challenge items
No execution or learned improvement claim
